marketplace.title: Ibikomoka ku buhinzi bishya biva ku bahinzi b'u Rwanda
marketplace.description: Shakisha ku gihingwa n'akarere, gereranya ibiciro kandi uvugane n'umuhinzi mu buryo butaziguye. Nta muntu uhuza.
marketplace.verifiedOnly: Abahinzi bagenzuwe cyangwa bemewe n'ikoperative gusa
marketplace.nearestNote: Kwegereye werekana ibicuruzwa by'akarere kawe mbere, hanyuma ay'intara yawe, hanyuma ay'ahandi mu Rwanda. Abasura bataranditse ntibafite aho baherereye babona ibishya mbere.
marketplace.invalidFiltersBody: Hari agaciro mu aderesi katamenyekana. Kuraho amashunguruzi wongere ugerageze.
marketplace.emptyBody: Gerageza igihingwa, akarere cyangwa igiciro bitandukanye, cyangwa ukureho amashunguruzi.

product.contactPrivacy: Numero za telefoni na imeri ntizigaragara ku ruhame. Ganira muri SARURA kugira ngo impande zombi zibone icyemezo cy'ibyumvikanyweho.
product.loginNote: Uzasubira kuri iki gicuruzwa nyuma yo kwinjira.
product.contactReadyBody: Ubutumwa n'ibisabwa byo kugura birimo kongerwa mu ntambwe ikurikira. Kugeza ubwo, komeza urebe isoko kandi ugaruke kuri iki gicuruzwa igihe ikiganiro kizafunguka.
product.safetyOne: Mumvikane ku giciro, ingano n'aho mufatira mbere yo kugenda.
product.safetyThree: Bahanganire ahantu hari abantu benshi kandi ntuzereke amafaranga ku muntu utazi.
product.errorBody: Ntitwabashije kubona iki gicuruzwa. Ongera ugerageze.

farmer.emptyBody: Uyu muhinzi nta bicuruzwa yatangaje ubu. Ongera uze hanyuma.

howItWorks.title: Intambwe eshatu ku bahinzi, eshatu ku baguzi
howItWorks.description: SARURA ihuza abahinzi n'abaguzi mu buryo butaziguye. Kureba ni ubuntu kandi nta muntu uhuza ushyiraho igiciro.
howItWorks.farmersDescription: Hindura umusaruro wawe ikiganiro gitaziguye n'umuguzi.
howItWorks.farmerStep1Body: Fungura konti y'ubuntu, emeza imeri yawe kandi ushyireho akarere kawe. Nyuma ushobora gusaba gugenzurwa cyangwa kwemezwa n'ikoperative.
howItWorks.farmerStep2Body: Shyiraho igihingwa, ingano, igiciro na foto. Ibicuruzwa bifite aho biherereye neza n'igiciro gisobanutse bibona ibisubizo byinshi.
howItWorks.farmerStep3Body: Ganira ku giciro n'ingano, mumvikane ku gufatira no kwishyura, hanyuma wandike ko igicuruzwa cyacurujwe kigishizeho.
howItWorks.buyersDescription: Shakisha ibicuruzwa ushobora kugenzura no kumvikana ku giciro n'umuhinzi.
howItWorks.buyerStep1Body: Shakisha ku gihingwa, akarere, igiciro n'urwego rw'iyemeza. Ntugomba kuba ufite konti kugira ngo urebe.
howItWorks.buyerStep2Body: Fungura igicuruzwa kandi uvugane n'umuhinzi ku ngano, igiciro n'aho mufatira cyangwa uko kizatwarwa.
howItWorks.buyerStep3Body: Emeza ibyumvikanyweho mu kiganiro, suzuma igicuruzwa kandi wishyure umuhinzi mu buryo butaziguye. SARURA ntiyishyura mu verisiyo ya mbere.
howItWorks.ctaBody: Abahinzi batangaza ku buntu mu gihe cy'igerageza; abaguzi bashobora kureba no kuvugana n'abahinzi nta kwishyura SARURA.

about.title: Isoko ritaziguye ku bahinzi n'abaguzi b'u Rwanda
about.description: SARURA ni isoko ry'ubuhinzi riri kubakwa i Kigali kugira ngo hagabanuke urugendo hagati y'abahinza ibiribwa n'ababikenera.
about.problemBody: Umubare munini w'umusaruro mwiza ugurwa unyuze mu nzira ndende aho umuhinzi ahabwa umugabane muto kandi umuguzi ntamenye aho ibiribwa byaturutse.
about.farmersBody: Kubona umuguzi wizewe akenshi biterwa n'amahirwe, abahuza cyangwa urugendo rurerure ku isoko. Ibiciro ntibizwi kandi umusaruro utagurishijwe uratakara.
about.buyersBody: Abaguzi bagorwa no kubona ibicuruzwa bihamye, kugereranya ibiciro nyakuri no kumenya niba umucuruzi yizewe.
about.missionBody: Korohereza ubucuruzi butaziguye hagati y'abahinzi n'abaguzi b'u Rwanda, ku buryo bworoshye, busobanutse kandi bwiza.
about.missionBodyTwo: Dushyiraho ibicuruzwa bisobanutse, twerekana urwego rw'iyemeza kandi tugatuma ikiganiro cya mbere kiba mu kiganiro kibikwa, kugira ngo impande zombi zimenye ibyumvikanyweho.
about.stepListBody: Umuhinzi ashobora gutangaza umusaruro n'ingano, igiciro n'aho biherereye.
about.stepDiscoverBody: Umuguzi ashakisha ku gihingwa, akarere n'igiciro, agereranya kandi agasoma umwirondoro w'umuhinzi.
about.stepNegotiateBody: Impande zombi ziganira ku giciro n'ingano, zemeranya hanyuma zikora ubucuruzi mu buryo butaziguye.
about.storyBody: SARURA yatangiye ku kintu kimwe cyoroshye: abahinzi n'abaguzi bombi bashaka ikintu kimwe — ubucuruzi bwiza kandi bwizewe — ariko akenshi nta nzira itaziguye yo kubonana.
about.storyBodyTwo: Verisiyo ya mbere yibanda ku karere kamwe, ku bicuruzwa nyakuri n'ibiganiro nyakuri. Tuyubaka hamwe n'abahinzi, abaguzi n'amakoperative mu Rwanda aho kwiyumvira ibyo bakenera.
about.teamBody: SARURA ibakwa n'itsinda rito i Kigali, rikorana n'abahinzi, abaguzi n'amakoperative. Tuzatangaza amakuru y'itsinda n'inkuru y'uwashinze SARURA mbere yo gutangira.
about.teamBodyTwo: Uko igerageza rikura, iyi paji izerekana abantu bakora SARURA n'abafatanyabikorwa bashyigikira umurimo.

contact.title: Twandikire
contact.description: Ufite ikibazo ku isoko, konti cyangwa ubufatanye? Twandikire kandi tuzagusubiza.
contact.formBody: Uzuza ifishi. Imeri yawe ntizizagaragazwa ku ruhame.
contact.name: Amazina yombi
contact.subject: Impamvu
contact.success: Murakoze. Ubutumwa bwawe bwakiriwe. Tuzagusubiza vuba.
contact.rateLimited: Wakoze ubutumwa bwinshi mu gihe gito. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
contact.privacyNote: Ubutumwa bwawe bukoreshwa gusa mu gusubiza ikibazo cyawe. Reba
contact.helpBody: Reba uko SARURA ikora cyangwa usome amategeko y'isoko mbere yo kutwandikira.

privacy.title: Ingingo ku bwumvikane bw'amakuru
privacy.description: Iyi ngingo isobanura amakuru SARURA ikusanya, impamvu iyakusanya, abashobora kuyabona n'uko uyagenzura.
privacy.collectBody: Iyo wiyandikishije, dukusanya amazina, imeri, numero ya telefoni n'akarere (intara, akarere n'umurenge). Niba uri umuhinzi, dukusanya kandi ibicuruzwa, ingano, ibiciro, foto n'ibisobanuro by'umusaruro wawe. Dukusanya kandi ubutumwa bugenda mu biganiro bya SARURA.
privacy.whyBody: Dukoresha amakuru mu gukora konti yawe, kugira ngo abaguzi babone ibicuruzwa, kugufasha kuvugana n'abandi, kurinda umutekano no kunoza serivisi.
privacy.whoBody: Amazina, akarere, urwego rw'iyemeza n'ibicuruzwa byawe bigaragara ku ruhame. Numero ya telefoni na imeri ntizigaragara ku ruhame. Abakozi ba SARURA babona amakuru y'konti gusa mu bufasha, mu iperereza cyangwa mu mutekano.
privacy.whoBodyTwo: Ntabwo tugurisha amakuru yawe ku bandi.
privacy.chatsBody: Ibiganiro bibikwa kuri seriveri za SARURA. Abantu babiri baganira gusa ni bo bashobora kubisoma; abakozi ba SARURA babisoma gusa iyo hari ikirego cyangwa ikibazo cy'umutekano. Ibiganiro nta gikorwa mu gihe cy'amezi 12 birasibwa.
privacy.retentionBody: Dukomeza amakuru y'konti igihe konti ikiri gukora. Ubutumwa bukomeza imyaka 12 nta gikorwa, hanyuma busibwe. Ibicuruzwa byashyizwe ku ruhande bikomeza kubikwa kugira ngo inyandiko z'ubucuruzi zisobanuke. Ubutumwa bwo mu ifishi yo kutwandikira bukomeza imyaka 12 nyuma yo gusubizwa.
privacy.rightsBody: Ushobora kubona, guhindura cyangwa gusaba gusiba amakuru yawe. Hindura umwirondoro wawe uri mu konti yawe, cyangwa twandikire kuri privacy@sarura.rw usabe gukosora cyangwa gusiba konti.
privacy.rightsBodyTwo: Iyo konti isabwe gusibwa, dukuraho amakuru y'umuntu; inyandiko zimwe na zimwe zishobora kubikwa mu buryo butaziguye ku mpamvu z'umutekano cyangwa amategeko.
privacy.securityBody: Dukoresha uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru, harimo ijambobanga rikomezwa n'uburyo bwo kubika butazwi. Mu verisiyo ya mbere SARURA ntiyakira ubwishyu bwa digitale; abaguzi n'abahinzi bishyura mu buryo butaziguye.
privacy.contactBody: Ufite ikibazo ku makuru yawe? Twandikire kuri privacy@sarura.rw cyangwa ukoreshe ifishi yo kutwandikira. Turi i Kigali, u Rwanda.
privacy.legalNote: SARURA yubahiriza amategeko y'u Rwanda ku burenganzira bw'amakuru bwite. Iyi ngingo yoroshye izasubirwamo n'inama y'amategeko mbere yo gutangira serivisi.
privacy.moreBody: Reba amategeko y'isoko cyangwa twandikire ku kibazo cy'ubuzima bwite.

policies.title: Amategeko ya SARURA
policies.description: Aya ni amategeko agenga imikoreshereze y'isoko. Ayubahirizwa ku ruhame kandi ashobora guhinduka uko serivisi ikura.
policies.honestBody: Tangaza gusa ibikomoka ku buhinzi ufite. Ingago, igiciro, aho biherereye na foto bigomba kuba by'ukuri kandi bishya. Hindura cyangwa wandike ko igicuruzwa cyacurujwe igihe kitagishoboye.
policies.honestBodyTwo: Ntugashyire ibicuruzwa bitaragezwa cyangwa ibitari ibyawe.
policies.contactTitle: Nta nimero cyangwa imeri mu bicuruzwa
policies.contactBody: Ntushyire numero ya telefoni cyangwa imeri mu izina cyangwa ibisobanuro by'igicuruzwa. Abaguzi baganira nawe binyuze mu biganiro bya SARURA.
policies.abuseBody: Birabujijwe: uburiganya, ibicuruzwa by'ibinyoma, ibintu byibwe, guhohotera, gukoresha nabi ubutumwa, kuroga abandi cyangwa gukoresha SARURA mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko.
policies.reportsBody: Ushobora gutangaza igicuruzwa, umwirondoro cyangwa ikiganiro. Itsinda rya SARURA risuzuma ikirego, rishobora kubaza ibisobanuro, guhisha igicuruzwa cyangwa guhagarika konti mu gihe iperereza rikiri gukorwa.
policies.ordersBody: Mumvikane ku giciro, ingano, aho mufatira n'uko mushyura mu kiganiro mbere yo gukora ubucuruzi. Iyo ubwumvikane buhagaritswe, andika uwabuhagaritse n'impamvu. Uguhagarika kenshi bishobora gusuzumwa.
policies.accountsBody: Koresha umwirondoro wawe nyakuri, konti imwe kuri wewe, kandi ntushyire ijambobanga ryawe ku bandi. Urwego rw'iyemeza rugomba kuba rufite icyemezo nyakuri.
policies.enforcementBody: Bitewe n'uburemere, SARURA ishobora gutanga umuburo, gukuraho igicuruzwa, guhagarika konti cyangwa kuyihagarika burundu. Uburiganya bukomeye cyangwa iyobera rishobora guhagarika konti ako kanya.
policies.contactUsBody: Ufite ikibazo ku mategeko cyangwa ikirego? Twandikire kandi tuzagusubiza.
policies.helpBody: Soma uko SARURA ikora cyangwa twandikire ku kibazo cy'amategeko.

auth.roleBothHint: Gura kandi ugurishe ukoresheje konti imwe.

auth.forgotDescription: Andika imeri yawe tuguhe umurongo ufite igihe ntarengwa wo guhitamo ijambo ry'ibanga rishya.
auth.forgotSent: Niba imeri yawe ifitwe na konti ya SARURA, twohereje umurongo wo guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga. Reba imeri yawe, harimo na spam.
auth.resetDescription: Koresha nibura inyuguti 8. Umurongo ukoreshwa rimwe gusa kandi urangira nyuma y'igihe gito.
auth.resetDone: Ijambo ry'ibanga ryahinduwe. Ubu ushobora kwinjira.
auth.resetInvalid: Umurongo wo guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga ntukora cyangwa warangiye. Saba undi.

auth.verifyDone: Imeri yawe yemejwe. Konti yawe ubu igaragara nk'iyemejwe.
auth.verifyFailed: Umurongo wo kwemeza ntukora cyangwa warangiye.
auth.verifyMissing: Umurongo wo kwemeza ntuzuye. Fungura umurongo nk'uko waguriye mu imeri yawe.
auth.gateTitle: Injira kugira ngo uvugane n'uyu muhinzi
auth.gateBody: SARURA igumana ikiganiro cya mbere imbere mu ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo impande zombi zibone icyemezo cy'ibyumvikanyweho. Injira cyangwa ufungure konti y'ubuntu, tuzakugaruka kuri iki gicuruzwa.
auth.gateReturnNote: Uzasubira kuri iki gicuruzwa nyuma yo kwinjira cyangwa kwiyandikisha.

dashboard.title: Konti yawe ya SARURA
dashboard.description: Aha ni intangiriro ya konti yawe. Ibibaho byuzuye by'umuguzi n'umuhinzi bizaza mu ntambwe ikurikira.
dashboard.verifyHint: Reba imeri yawe niba hari ubutumwa bwo kwemeza. Kwemeza imeri bizamura konti yawe ku rwego rwa 'Konti yemejwe'.
dashboard.nextBody: Ibibaho birimo kubakwa mu ntambwe. Bizaba birimo:
dashboard.nextFarmer: Umuhinzi: kongeramo no guhindura ibicuruzwa, kwerekana ibyacurujwe no gusubiza ibisabwa byo kugura.
dashboard.nextBuyer: Umuguzi: ibyo wasabye, amabwiriza y'ibyaguzwe, ibicuruzwa wabitse n'umwirondoro wawe.

sell.title: Curuza umusaruro wawe mu buryo butaziguye ku baguzi
sell.description: Tangaza ibyo ufite, shyiraho igiciro cyawe kandi usubize abaguzi mu buryo butaziguye. Gutangaza ni ubuntu mu gihe cy'igerageza.
sell.buyerBody: Konti imwe ishobora no kugurisha. Ibikoresho by'umuhinzi n'uburyo bwo kongeramo uruhare rw'umuhinzi kuri iyi konti bizaza mu ntambwe y'ibibaho.
sell.stepListBody: Ongeraho igihingwa, ingano, igiciro, aho biherereye na foto.
sell.stepAnswerBody: Subiza abaguzi ku giciro n'ingano muri SARURA.
sell.stepAgreeBody: Emeza ibyaguzwe, muhurire, musuzume kandi wishyurirwe mu buryo butaziguye.
sell.requirementOne: Konti ya SARURA y'ubuntu irimo amazina yawe nyayo na numero ya telefoni.
sell.requirementTwo: Intara, akarere n'umurenge wawe kugira ngo abaguzi bakubone.
sell.requirementThree: Amakuru nyayo kuri buri gicuruzwa: igihingwa, ingano n'igiciro kuri kg.
sell.note: Foto si ngombwa, ariko ibicuruzwa bifite foto igaragara n'igiciro kigemye bibona ibisubizo byinshi. Ntushyire numero ya telefoni cyangwa imeri mu gitangazwa; abaguzi baguvugisha binyuze muri SARURA.
